Shell.headline: A clear workspace to manage your business.
Shell.description: Access your company workspaces and the management tools linked to your account, with permissions organized by company.
Shell.footer: PolyGest · For business owners and teams.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.description: Enter the credentials associated with your account to access your workspace.
Login.checkEmail: If this address can be registered, a confirmation message has been sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.

errors.missing-fields: Enter your email address and password.
errors.invalid-email: The email address format is invalid.
errors.password-too-long: The password exceeds the maximum allowed length.
errors.email-not-confirmed: This email address has not been confirmed yet. Check the message sent when you registered.
errors.invalid-credentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
errors.confirmation-failed: The confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Restart registration or contact support.
errors.generic: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.

Register.title: Create an account
Register.description: Create your PolyGest access to set up your first company workspace.
Register.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters. You can set up your company next.

errors.invalid-name: Your full name must contain between 2 and 100 characters.
errors.invalid-email: The email address format is invalid.
errors.password-too-long: The password must not exceed 128 characters.
errors.password-too-short: The password must contain at least 8 characters.
errors.signup-failed: The account could not be created. Check your details and try again.
errors.generic: Registration could not be completed. Please try again.

ForgotPassword.title: Reset your password
ForgotPassword.description: Enter the email address associated with your account. If an account can receive a recovery link, a message will be sent.
ForgotPassword.checkEmail: If an account is associated with this address, a recovery link will be sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.

errors.invalid-email: The email address format is invalid.
errors.generic: The request could not be processed. Please try again.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.description: Set a new password to secure your PolyGest account.
ResetPassword.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters. Your account's Supabase security rules still apply.
ResetPassword.successDescription: You can now continue to your workspace.
ResetPassword.invalidSession: This password recovery session is invalid or has expired. Request a new recovery link.

errors.password-too-short: The password must contain at least 8 characters.
errors.password-too-long: The password must not exceed 128 characters.
errors.invalid-session: The recovery session is invalid or has expired. Request a new link.
errors.update-failed: The password could not be updated. Check the security requirements and try again.
errors.generic: The password could not be changed. Please try again.

Onboarding.title: Create your company workspace
Onboarding.description: Enter your company details to start organizing your business with PolyGest.
Onboarding.securityError: A security check is required before your first workspace can be created.
Onboarding.verificationFailed: We could not verify the companies linked to this account. To avoid creating a duplicate, the form is temporarily unavailable.

errors.missing-name: The legal company name is required.
errors.invalid-name: The legal company name must contain between 2 and 200 characters.
errors.invalid-trade-name: The trading name must contain between 2 and 200 characters.
errors.invalid-company-data: The company details are invalid. Check the names you entered.
errors.creation-failed: The company could not be created. Check the details and try again.

WorkspaceNotice.title: Your workspace is ready
WorkspaceNotice.description: The English translation of the dashboard and management modules is in progress. For this first step, those screens remain available in French.
WorkspaceNotice.continue: Continue to the workspace in French

Home.title: Dashboard
Home.directoryDescription: Each company has its own customer and supplier directories.
Home.membershipErrorHelp: Check the Supabase schema and access policies.
Home.noCompaniesDescription: Create a company or ask its owner to invite you to get started.
Home.previewError: Unable to load records from this directory.
Home.customerEmpty: No active customer records are visible for this company.
Home.supplierEmpty: No active supplier records are visible for this company.

Contacts.selectCompanyDescription: Select the company you want to work with.
Contacts.directoriesPerCompany: Directories are kept separate for each company.
Contacts.companyNotAccessible: This company is not accessible with your account.
Contacts.description: {company} · Manage contact details and payment terms.
Contacts.accessDeniedDescription: Your role in this company does not allow access to the {kind} directory. Ask the owner to review your permissions.
Contacts.requiredFields: Fields marked with an asterisk are required.
Contacts.archiveInsteadOfDelete: Permanent deletion is not available; records can be archived.
Contacts.directoryDescription: Search by name and filter active or archived records.
Contacts.noRecordsDescription: Change the filters or add the first record if your role allows it.
Contacts.maxRecords: A maximum of 100 records is shown. Refine your search to find a specific record.
Contacts.footer: Access is controlled by company permissions and Supabase row-level security (RLS).

errors.access: Unable to access this company. Check your membership and try again.
errors.invalid: Some information is invalid. Check the fields and their lengths.
errors.save: The operation was denied or failed. Check your permissions and the information entered.
errors.notFound: This record is no longer accessible or your role does not allow you to edit it.
errors.loadList: Unable to load records. Try again or check your permissions.

success.archived: The record was archived and remains available in the history.

Documents.title: Related documents
Documents.privacy: Documents are private. Only members with permission to view this module can open them.
Documents.allowedTypes: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP · 20 MiB maximum
Documents.scannerDisabled: File uploads are paused until the antivirus scanning engine is configured. Existing attachments remain subject to their access permissions.

messages.loadFailed: Unable to load attachments or access is not permitted.
messages.serviceUnavailable: The document service is temporarily unavailable.
messages.invalidSize: The file must be between 1 byte and 20 MiB.
messages.invalidFormat: File type rejected. The content must be a valid PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP.
messages.permissionDenied: Your role does not allow you to add a document to this record.
messages.storageMissing: Private storage is not configured in this environment yet.
messages.tooLarge: The file exceeds the 20 MiB limit.
messages.sessionFailed: The upload session could not be created. Please try again.
messages.uploadFailed: Storage rejected the file. Check your connection and try again.
messages.completionFailed: The file was transferred, but its upload session could not be completed.
messages.scanPending: The file was uploaded. It will remain inaccessible until its security scan is complete.

Members.title: Members and access
Members.selectCompany: Choose the company you want to manage.
Members.companyNotAccessible: This company is not accessible with your account.
Members.subtitle: Review access and invitations.
Members.inviteDescription: Enter the email address of a user who is already registered on PolyGest and choose their role. A confirmation email will be sent. After confirmation, the owner can activate access following a review.
Members.privilegedRolesNotice: Owner and administrator roles grant extended permissions. Assign them only to people you trust.
Members.invitationDeliveryNotice: A confirmation email valid for seven days will be sent. If email delivery fails, a link you can share yourself will be displayed.
Members.membersDescription: Pending invitations remain separate from active access.
Members.emptyDescription: This company’s member list is currently empty.
Members.securityFooter: Member access and invitation creation are rechecked by Supabase SQL functions and security policies.

errors.invalid: Check the email address, company and selected role.
errors.access: This company is not accessible with your account.
errors.permission: Your role does not allow you to assign this role or manage members.
errors.duplicate: This account already has a membership in this company.
errors.noAccount: No active account was found for this address. The person must first create a PolyGest account.
errors.emailConfig: Email delivery is not configured. Check the server-side RESEND_API_KEY, RESEND_FROM_EMAIL and NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL settings.
errors.emailFailed: The invitation was saved, but the email was not sent. Check the Resend configuration and try again.
errors.emailRateLimit: Wait at least one minute before resending this email.
errors.save: The operation could not be saved. Check permissions and try again.
errors.notFound: This invitation is no longer pending or is not accessible.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: The recipient must confirm their email address before activation.
errors.listPermission: Your role does not allow you to view this company’s member list.
errors.listFailed: Unable to load members. Please try again later.

success.invited: The invitation was saved and the confirmation email was sent.
success.invitedLink: The invitation was saved, but the email was not sent. Share the link below with the invited person.

Members.linkTitle: Invitation link (valid for 7 days, single use)
Members.linkInstructions: Share this link only with the invited person (WhatsApp, SMS, etc.). It works only when they sign in with the invited email address. The link will no longer be shown after it is read.

Companies.title: Create a company
Companies.description: Add a new independent management workspace to your account.
Companies.informationDescription: Each company has its own members, directories and management data.
Companies.ownerNotice: You will become the owner of this new workspace. There is no fixed company limit in the MVP scope.

errors.invalidName: The legal name must contain between 2 and 200 characters.
errors.invalidTradeName: The trading name must contain between 2 and 200 characters.
errors.invalidCompanyData: The company information is invalid. Check the names you entered.
errors.creationFailed: Company creation failed. Check your permissions and try again.
